visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of feature/promo cards with optional photo or icon, heading, text and a link or button pinned to the bottom

contentPattern.structure: image or icon (optional, own cell) | body cell with optional eyebrow, heading, text and a final paragraph of links/buttons (rendered as the card CTA). Mark an individual card dark by starting a paragraph with `(dark)` (e.g. a `(dark)` paragraph on its own) or by adding an extra cell containing `dark`; the marker is stripped and the card gets the `.dark` card styling

usage: Use for 2-4 column rows of feature cards (photo or icon, heading, copy, CTA). Default renders light cards; add the `dark` option to make every card dark. For a mixed row (one dark card among light cards) keep the default and mark the dark card with a `(dark)` paragraph or an extra `dark` cell. Section background comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black), not from a block class.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any card grid where each card is a self-contained promo with its own surface. Use cards-icon for bare icons without card surfaces and cards-article for article/blog teasers.
